context.name: Issues With DigiD as a Foreigner
context.content: In reply to Issues With DigiD as a Foreigner by Henrique Dias That’s very inconvenient. So what’s the alternative, if you can’t use DigId? Going by in person somewhere, phone based? And will the EU ID efforts help, because those aim at being able to log into gov services across the EU with your own national government e-ID method, iirc?
